description: This file declares external API functions for the Http Ato FxCat1 object, which appears to be part of an HTTP protocol implementation related to the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the object.

methods.name: HttpCreateAtoFxCat1
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Http Ato FxCat1 object.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat1Create
methods.description: Constructs an Http Ato FxCat1 object.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat1Remove
methods.description: Removes an existing Http Ato FxCat1 object.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat1EnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Http Ato FxCat1 instance.

methods.name: HttpAtoFxCat1Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Http Ato FxCat1 object.
